<infobox theme="City">
	<image source="imagefallback">
		<default>{{InfoboxGallery|image={{{image|}}}|caption1={{{option1|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{option2|}}}}}</default>
	</image>
    <title source="name"></title>
	<navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
	<group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>	
        <data source="constructed"><label>Constructed</label></data>	
        <data source="destroyed"><label>Destroyed</label></data>
        <data source="rebuilt"><label>Rebuilt</label></data>	
        <data source="builder"><label>Builder</label></data>
        <data source="mayor"><label>Mayor</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Location information</header>
    	<data source="celestialbody"><label>Celestial body</label></data>
        <data source="continent"><label>Continent</label></data>
        <data source="location"><label>Location</label></data>
        <data source="climate"><label>Climate</label></data>
        <data source="interest"><label>Points of interest</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Societal information</header>
        <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>
        <data source="demonym"><label>Demonym</label></data>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:City|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|constructed|destroyed|rebuilt|builder|mayor|celestialbody|continent|location|climate|interest|population|demonym|affiliation|optional=option1,image2,option2|ignore=name}}<noinclude>[[category:Location infobox templates]]
===Usage===
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre>{{Top|}}
{{City
|image=
|name=
|constructed=
|destroyed=
|rebuilt=
|builder=
|mayor=
|celestialbody=
|continent=
|location=
|climate=
|interest=
|population=
|demonym=
|affiliation=
}}</pre>

===Notes===
*[[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe#Infobox]] indicates that a Demonym introduced in the infobox field is not required to also be mentioned in the body of the article (though it optionally can be).</noinclude>
